frontmatter.title: Software Engineering and Customer Service: The Overlooked Duo
frontmatter.subheading: Why Customer Service Skills Are Essential in the Coding World
frontmatter.excerpt: Delve into the often-ignored relationship between software engineering and customer service. Learn why customer service is a critical soft skill for software engineers, and how mastering it can make a difference in your career and projects.
frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
